adjudication.rationale: The diff shows only a 60s throttle in `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` using `$redis.setnx`/`expire` on `"retrieved:#{@embed_url}"`, but no lock/mutex around the actual work in `perform_retrieve` (which can call `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` and/or `fetch_http`). If `perform_retrieve` takes >60s, the redis key can expire and another concurrent `retrieve` can enter while `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: @embed_url).exists?` is still false. Also, there is no mutual exclusion between scheduled `Jobs::PollFeed` (hourly) and this inline invocation. Concurrent runs can duplicate expensive work and can race in `TopicEmbed.import`: both can see `embed.blank?` and attempt to create, relying on the unique index on `topic_embeds.embed_url` to prevent duplicates, which can still surface as a unique-constraint exception/wasted work.
